**Welcome!**

I am a [Clinical Assistant Professor in the Quantitative Methods Department](https://business.purdue.edu/academics/quantitative-methods/) at Purdue University's Mitch Daniels School of Business. My research and teaching center on applied data science, spanning statistics, natural language processing, predictive analytics, causal inference, and artificial intelligence.

Before Purdue, I held Visiting Assistant Professor positions at the [Department of Data and Decision Sciences at Emory University](https://datascience.emory.edu/) and the [School of Global Policy and Strategy at UC San Diego](https://gps.ucsd.edu/), and was an Assistant Professor in the [Political Science Department at the Federal University of Pernambuco (UFPE) in Brazil](https://www.ufpe.br/dcp).

## Current roles

-   Clinical Assistant Professor, [Quantitative Methods Department](https://business.purdue.edu/academics/quantitative-methods/), Purdue University
-   Director, Daniels Undergraduate Business Honors Program
-   Director, [SIGNAL Lab](research.qmd#grants), John Martinson Honors College
-   John Martinson Honors College Fellow and Honors Research Fellow
